summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state set and cleared in the run entry point, and added tests/test_call_from_thread.py. All 9 new tests pass on the prepared Python 3.9 environment when run with PYTHONPATH=src, because the venv's textual points at the base tree. Nothing is committed. Three existing async tests (test_call_later.py x2, test_unmount.py) fail because this environment lacks an async pytest plugin; I did not confirm they fail on the base tree.
